gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-gujarati: Stencil cuts and tall letters: Snowburst One shouts first. Anek Gujarati takes over in friendly sans-serif, its lowercase nearly as large as the capitals, so paragraphs move along without effort.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil brings big round bowls and half-unwrapped curves, a modern sans tucked under Snowburst One. Its generous roundness is the whole appeal against that stencil shout.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-telugu: Snowburst One hits like a stencil sheet, tall and bold. Anek Telugu settles into wide, tall bowls left unlatched, a sans whose rhythm rolls on smoothly for as long as you keep reading.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-armata: Armata reads spacious, its lowercase filling most of the letter height. Snowburst One brings the stencil bridges and tall lowercase, a bold, expressive contrast to that tidy sans underneath.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-carrois-gothic-s: Carrois Gothic SC is approachable sans-serif with a clear opening at every curve, sitting below the stencil drama of Snowburst One. Capitals and lowercase sit nearly level, so text moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-duru-sans: Expressive Snowburst One sprays stencil cuts and tall lowercase, while Duru Sans stays a modern plain sans with wide openings. Its big bodies fill each line, so text reads smooth and quick.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-fresca: Stencil-cut and loud, Snowburst One leads Fresca, a modern sans-serif with single-weight strokes and short ascenders. Its counters stay connected to the outside, so paragraphs feel open and unhurried.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps a constant line weight, humming along like a quiet sans. Above it, Snowburst One shouts in stencil cuts, and that steady hum below lets the loudness stay contained.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-geist: Clean describes Geist, a sans-serif with a quiet level beat, whose words read as solid blocks beside Snowburst One. Save the stencil heading for big, short lines, where its wide bridges show.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-georama: Georama reads friendly, its c wide like a bracelet pulled apart. Snowburst One shouts in stencil cuts above it, and that sans lets the loud heading do all the talking.
